sections.eyebrow: Lower your expectations. Feel at home.
sections.heading: Go away. We're in dispair.
sections.body: Come as you are. Sit quietly, join in, or slip out early. We won’t ask you to explain your face.

sections.heading: A place to belong. More or less.
sections.description:
For the weary, the wondering, and anyone who’s had enough of being told to “stay positive.” Despair offers a quiet place to gather, a cup of coffee that’s technically warm, and the comfort of not having to pretend everything’s fine.

No pressure. No grand promises. Just people, a place to sit, and whatever happens next.

locations.name: Middle of nowhere
locations.description: You'll know it when you find it
